'''Aquila Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mwpipe.com/mwpipe/pdf/WI_Shipper_Advisory_Board_Meeting_Spring_2026.pdf|title=mwpipe.com|website=mwpipe.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pscdocs.utah.gov/electric/25docs/25266001/342811NtcRgstrnLrgSclGnrtnPrvdr11-24-2025.pdf|title=pscdocs.utah.gov|website=pscdocs.utah.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from MountainWest Pipeline Goshen interconnect, Utah to Aquila power plant, Eagle Mountain, Utah.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mwpipe.com/mwpipe/pdf/WI_Shipper_Advisory_Board_Meeting_Spring_2026.pdf|title=mwpipe.com|website=mwpipe.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pscdocs.utah.gov/electric/25docs/25266001/342811NtcRgstrnLrgSclGnrtnPrvdr11-24-2025.pdf|title=pscdocs.utah.gov|website=pscdocs.utah.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
